title: KronML UI Platform
description: A production-facing React application built for KronML to streamline user access, tenant-based workflows, and API communication.
problem: The team needed a fast, reliable UI layer for managing tenant-specific actions while avoiding CORS issues and keeping API traffic efficient.
solution: Built the frontend in React, used NGINX as a reverse proxy to avoid CORS problems, added a cache layer to reduce repeated API calls, and containerized the app with Docker before deploying it on Kubernetes.
outcome: The system made deployment and runtime access more predictable, improved communication between the UI and API, and reduced unnecessary backend load.

title: DockNet
description: A container-focused infrastructure project built to simplify service setup, deployment, and local environment consistency.
problem: Development and deployment workflows were difficult to standardize across environments, and manual setup made it easy for services to drift or fail inconsistently.
solution: Designed a Docker-based workflow for packaging services, orchestrating dependencies, and reducing friction around setup and repeatable deployments.
outcome: The system improved environment consistency, reduced setup overhead, and made service deployment easier to reproduce across machines.

title: Tangle SG
description: A distributed-systems style project inspired by DAG-based ledger design for handling structured data flow and scalable transaction-like updates.
problem: Traditional centralized storage can become a bottleneck when the system needs fast propagation, auditability, or distributed update handling.
solution: Built a prototype around tangle-style data relationships, focusing on efficient propagation, structured linking, and a design that could support decentralized or semi-decentralized workflows.
outcome: The project demonstrated an alternative architecture for handling linked updates and gave a clear base for discussions around scalability, trust, and data integrity.

title: Finance AI System (MVP)
description: A low-cost AI system prototype designed to support finance-related workflows through modular tools and automation.
problem: The target use case needed a practical AI assistant that could help with finance workflows without requiring a large upfront build cost or a heavy production stack.
solution: Designed the system around modular tools, reusable workflows, and a lightweight MVP architecture so the product could be demoed quickly and expanded later.
outcome: The MVP served as a strong proof of concept for automation-driven finance operations and created a clear path toward a more production-ready version.

title: Client Onboarding Automation System
description: A streamlined onboarding workflow for collecting client data, validating inputs, and initiating internal setup steps.
problem: Manual onboarding created delays, inconsistent data collection, and unnecessary back-and-forth before work could begin.
solution: Built a structured onboarding flow with forms, validation, backend processing, and workflow triggers to automate intake and reduce manual handling.
outcome: The process became easier to manage, reduced repetitive manual work, and made client setup more consistent across cases.

title: Online Payment Infrastructure
description: A backend payment system built to support secure transaction handling and reliable payment-related workflows.
problem: The application needed a dependable way to process payments, track transaction status, and handle webhook-driven updates without breaking the flow.
solution: Implemented the payment flow with secure backend handling, transaction tracking, and webhook support so payment state could stay synchronized across the system.
outcome: The integration supported stable payment processing and reduced the risk of inconsistent transaction states across the application.

title: Bitcoin Wallet Integration
description: A crypto wallet integration for handling address management and Bitcoin transaction workflows.
problem: The system needed a way to support wallet operations and blockchain-facing actions while keeping the backend organized and maintainable.
solution: Built wallet-related logic for address handling, transaction flow, and external blockchain integration.
outcome: The project established a working foundation for crypto-related backend operations and showed the ability to integrate with blockchain systems.

title: Admin Management Console
description: An internal dashboard for managing users, system data, and operational controls.
problem: Internal teams needed a centralized way to manage records and monitor system activity without depending on ad hoc scripts or manual database edits.
solution: Built a structured admin interface with reusable components, role-friendly layouts, and efficient data handling for internal operations.
outcome: The console made internal management more organized, reduced operational friction, and gave teams a clearer control surface.

title: E-commerce Platform
description: A full-stack e-commerce application with product browsing, cart handling, order flow, and authentication.
problem: The business needed a complete online storefront with a smooth purchase journey and manageable backend administration.
solution: Built the shopping flow end to end, including product pages, cart logic, checkout flow, and user authentication.
outcome: The platform delivered a functional digital storefront and a reusable base for future commerce features.

title: Restaurant & Cafe Landing Pages
description: Modern landing pages for hospitality businesses built to improve presentation, responsiveness, and customer engagement.
problem: Restaurants and cafes needed attractive, fast-loading websites that communicated value quickly and looked good on mobile devices.
solution: Designed and developed responsive landing pages with clear visual hierarchy, strong calls to action, and polished presentation.
outcome: The pages improved brand presentation and gave businesses a stronger digital presence for customer discovery and conversion.

title: IoT Automation System
description: A hackathon-built IoT system created under tight time constraints for real-world device integration and automation.
problem: The challenge required a working prototype that could connect hardware and software reliably within a short build window.
solution: Built the system rapidly, integrated the necessary hardware and software components, and focused on a functional demo that could be tested under pressure.
outcome: The project showed strong execution under time pressure and proved the ability to build and ship a working IoT solution quickly.

title: Track-it
description: A task and project management application designed to help users organize work, track progress, and manage tasks more effectively.
problem: Users needed a simpler way to manage tasks and projects without jumping between scattered tools or overly complex systems.
solution: Built a clean task management app with structured project organization, task tracking, and a straightforward user interface.
outcome: The application provided a practical productivity workflow and a clear example of a usable internal-style management tool.

title: Oikotaan Festival Website
description: A festival website built to centralize event information, schedules, travel details, and ticketing-related content.
problem: Festival attendees needed one place to find all event information instead of searching across disconnected social media posts and announcements.
solution: Created a responsive event website with clear sections for lineup, schedule, travel information, accommodation, and ticket-related actions.
outcome: The site acted as a central information hub and made it easier for attendees to plan their event experience.
